Rankeds.intro: This is where you play real duels against other real players, with ELO and rank — different from regular practice, which doesn't affect your competitive standing.

Rankeds.teRetaronAUno: You've been challenged to a duel

metadata.title: Shop
metadata.description: Spend your Chispas on shields, boosts, and cosmetics from Prodigia's bazaar.

descripciones.escudo: One more calibration shield for your next match.
descripciones.congelamiento: If you miss a day of practice, your streak won't break.
descripciones.boost: ×1.5 Chispas on your next match, any world.

Tienda.noSePudoComprarConexion: Couldn't complete the purchase. Check your connection.
Tienda.noSePudoCambiarFuenteConexion: Couldn't change the font. Check your connection.
Tienda.noSePudoCambiarMarcoConexion: Couldn't change the frame. Check your connection.
Tienda.noSePudoApostarConexion: Couldn't place the bet. Check your connection.
Tienda.vidrieraDescripcion: How your name looks on your profile, the ranking, and the feed. Cosmetic — doesn't change anything about the match.
Tienda.herreroDescripcion: A cosmetic border for your name on your profile — the same colors as Rankeds ranks.
Tienda.vidrieraMarcosTematicosDescripcion: A different ring for each world, for your avatar. Unlocks at level {n} in that world — or free, as a gift, if you fully master it.

Tienda.paqueteMarcosMundoCompleto: You already have all 6 world frames
Tienda.dobleONadaDescripcion: Bet Chispas that your next match beats your historical accuracy. If you win, it doubles.
Tienda.dobleONadaAviso: This never uses real money — it's only with your in-game Chispas. Max bet: {max} Chispas. You can hide this section from Settings if you'd rather not see it.
Tienda.apuestaActivaAviso: You have an active bet — it settles with your next match.
Tienda.sotanoDescripcion: The Bazaar's basement — where Prodigia makes its most dangerous deals.

apuestasPartida.descripcion: Other players' duels, live. Pick a side, pay your stake and let the best win.

apuestasPartida.sinChispas: You don't have enough Chispas for that stake.

prediccionRanking.descripcion: Bet where you'll end up in the weekly ranking. Get it right and the house pays you.
prediccionRanking.ventanaCerrada: The betting window opens Monday and closes Wednesday. The next one starts Monday.
prediccionRanking.hecha: Prediction locked in. See you on the last day of the ranking.

laCalcu.completa: Finish the sequence: numbers and operations, in that order.
laCalcu.fallida: Doesn't hit the target. Your bet is gone.

acertijos.descripcion: Memorize the sequence and replay it in the exact order. It gets tricky by the third one.

elReloj.descripcion: 15 additions and subtractions before time runs out. The ones you miss count as wrong.

volado.descripcion: Heads or tails. You can stop after any round — or double down.

pizarra.descripcion: Guess the number between 1 and 100. Each question costs Chispas — you get 7 tries.

deteccionConexion.mensaje: We noticed your connection is slow — want to turn off the extra visual effects? You can change this anytime in Settings.

metadata.title: Prodigia — Train your brain while you play
metadata.description: Practice mental math, logic, geography, chemistry, and anatomy with short, competitive rounds. Start free, no account needed.

hero.titulo: Train your brain like it's a muscle
hero.subtitulo: Short, addictive rounds of math, logic, geography, chemistry, and anatomy. Pick a world and try it now — no account needed.

intro.texto: Short practice rounds, a live ranking, and duels against other players. You can take a 2-minute guided tutorial, or jump straight in.

grid.descripcion: A 5-question trial round, right away — no sign-up.

mecanismo.texto: It's 10 questions in 60 seconds. Answering in a streak buys you more seconds; answering faster earns you more Experience.

Landing.errorInvitado: We couldn't set up the demo. Try again.

tour.ranking: Ranking: compare your progress with every other player, overall and per world.
tour.rankeds: Rankeds: real duels against other players, with your own ELO and rank.
tour.amigos: Friends and Clans: follow your friends, challenge them, and join a team.
tour.perfil: Profile: your streak, your achievements, and your account frame, all in one place.

promo.titulo: And whenever you want, Prodigia Pro
promo.texto: Here's what you'll be able to get later on, if you want to move faster.

cta.titulo: Not bad for a first try!
cta.mensaje: Create your account to save your progress and keep your streak

metadata.title: Home

Home.chispasIntro: Chispas are the game's currency — you earn them by practicing and spend them at the Shop.

Home.retoSemanalDescripcion: 45 problems, the same for everyone this week
Home.tusMundosDescripcion: Each world has its own pace and its own path.

mundos.enigmia: Logic puzzles: sequences, patterns, and deduction.
mundos.geografia: Locate countries of the Americas on the map.
mundos.quimia: Elements, formulas, and the periodic table.
mundos.anatomia: Bones, muscles, organs, and the nervous system.
mundos.melodia: Staff notation, scales, and chords built from formulas.
mundos.trigonometria: Ratios, unit circle, identities, and triangles.
mundos.historia: Chronology, figures, cause and effect, and exact dates.

Aprender.subtitulo: One path: unlock techniques in order, or jump to a unit from the left.

descripcionUnidad.suma: Add faster by combining numbers in simpler ways.
descripcionUnidad.resta: Subtract with confidence, even when the numbers don't cooperate.
descripcionUnidad.multiplicacion: Multiply from memory with shortcuts that save steps.
descripcionUnidad.division: Divide in your head by spotting patterns before you calculate.
descripcionUnidad.fracciones: Work with fractions fearlessly: simplify, compare, add.
descripcionUnidad.decimales: Convert, round, and calculate percentages without losing your footing.
descripcionUnidad.potencias: Powers and roots with shortcuts, no brute force.
descripcionUnidad.algebra: Solve for x fearlessly: one step at a time, always checkable.
descripcionUnidad.geometria: Perimeters, areas, and Pythagorean triples — patterns, not formulas to memorize.
